sentences.text: Problem-based learning (PBL) is a teaching method in which students aim to learn about a subject through the experience of solving an open-ended problem found in trigger material.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a teaching method in which students aim to learn about a subject through the experience of solving an open-ended problem found in trigger material

relativeClauses.text: in which students aim to learn about a subject through the experience of solving an open-ended problem found in trigger material

subordinateClauses.text: to learn about a subject through the experience of solving an open-ended problem found in trigger material

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 PBL is a teaching method。in which 引导修饰 method 的定语从句，从句主干为 students aim to learn；through 表示学习途径，of solving 说明 experience 的内容，found in trigger material 是修饰 problem 的过去分词短语。

sentences.text: The PBL process does not focus on problem solving with a defined solution, but is designed for the development of other skills and attributes.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 同一主语 The PBL process 对应 does not focus ... 与 but is designed ...。前半否定以确定答案的解题为重点，后半说明培养其他技能和特质的设计目标；with a defined solution 修饰 problem solving 所涉及的问题。

sentences.text: This includes knowledge acquisition, enhanced group collaboration and communication.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: knowledge acquisition, enhanced group collaboration and communication

sentences.readingHintZh: This 回指上一句所说的发展内容。includes 后是并列名词短语：knowledge acquisition、enhanced group collaboration 和 communication；enhanced 是修饰语，不是本句的过去时谓语。

sentences.text: The PBL process was developed for medical education and has since been used for other programs of learning.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 同一主语 The PBL process 后接 was developed 与 has since been used 两个被动谓语。前者说明最初用途，后者用现在完成时说明此后的应用；since 在这里是“此后”的副词。

sentences.text: The process aims to allow for learners to develop skills used for their future practice.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to allow for learners to develop skills used for their future practice

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The process aims to allow ...，aim to 表示目的。learners 是 develop skills 的动作执行者；used for their future practice 是过去分词短语，后置修饰 skills，their 回指学习者。

sentences.text: The PBL tutorial process often involves working in small groups of learners.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: working in small groups of learners

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The PBL tutorial process often involves ...。involve 后接 working 这一动名词结构，in small groups 说明合作形式；of learners 修饰 groups。

sentences.text: Each student takes on a role within the group that may be formal or informal and the role often alternates.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a role within the group that may be formal or informal

relativeClauses.text: that may be formal or informal

sentences.readingHintZh: 第一分句主干 Each student takes on a role，take on 表示“承担”。that may be formal or informal 描述 role；and 后是独立分句 the role often alternates，说明角色会轮换。or 连接两个形容词。

sentences.text: It is focused on the student's reflection and reasoning to construct their own learning.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: It 指这一学习过程，is focused on 表示“着重于”。on 后 reflection 与 reasoning 并列；to construct their own learning 说明反思和推理的目的，their 指学生。

sentences.text: The Maastricht seven-jump process involves clarifying terms, defining problem(s), brainstorming, structuring and hypothesis, learning objectives, independent study and synthesising.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: clarifying terms, defining problem(s), brainstorming, structuring and hypothesis, learning objectives, independent study and synthesising

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The Maastricht seven-jump process involves ...，后面列举七步内容。注意原文混用动名词与名词短语；structuring and hypothesis 合为一个步骤，最后的 and 连接整个列表的末项 synthesising。

sentences.text: In short, it is identifying what they already know, what they need to know, and how and where to access new information that may lead to the resolution of the problem.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that may lead to the resolution of the problem

subordinateClauses.text: how and where to access new information that may lead to the resolution of the problem

sentences.readingHintZh: In short 表示总结。identifying 后并列三项：what they already know、what they need to know、how and where to access new information。前两项是 what 引导的名词性从句，第三项是疑问词加不定式；that may lead ... 修饰 information。

sentences.text: The role of the tutor within the process is to facilitate learning by supporting, guiding, and monitoring the learning process.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: The role of the tutor within the process

subordinateClauses.text: to facilitate learning by supporting, guiding, and monitoring the learning process

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The role ... is to facilitate learning，不定式作表语，说明导师职责。by 后 supporting、guiding、monitoring 三个动名词并列，说明促进学习的方法；它们共享 the learning process 这一对象。

sentences.text: The tutor aims to build the confidence of a student to address problems, while also expanding their understanding.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to build the confidence of a student to address problems, while also expanding their understanding

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The tutor aims to build the confidence ...。to address problems 说明学生应对问题的信心；while also expanding ... 是省略主语的分词结构，补充导师同时拓展学生理解，their 指学生。

sentences.text: This process is based on constructivism.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: This process 指前文的 PBL 学习过程。is based on 是“以……为基础”的固定结构；on 后 constructivism 是其理论基础，不是实施这一过程的人。

sentences.text: PBL has been described as a paradigm shift from traditional teaching and learning philosophy, which is more often lecture-based.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 PBL has been described as a paradigm shift，使用现在完成时的被动结构。from ... 表示转变所离开的传统理念；which 引导非限制性定语从句，描述传统教与学理念更常以讲授为主。

sentences.text: The constructs for teaching PBL may be different from traditional classroom or lecture teaching in a lecture style.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: different from traditional classroom or lecture teaching in a lecture style

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语中心词是 constructs，for teaching PBL 说明其用途。may be different from 表示“可能与……不同”；from 后的传统课堂或讲授式教学构成比较对象，teaching 不是与 may be 并列的另一个谓语。
